description: The clean cross-isotope C_knot universality test, run with the NOW-PINNED Markov weight y_λ (PR #4543, Σ y_λ f^λ = 1 verified). Master-formula conventions (binding_energy_categorical_deuteron): B(K) = m_e·|Σ_λ y_λ χ^λ(β_K) sgn f^λ|, χ^λ from the interface-inclusive Rust Hoefsmit caches. Result: C_knot = 6.0678734/6.7060686/4.9054474/290.00684 for D/T/³He/⁴He → spread 59.119×, NON-UNIVERSAL. f^λ (hook SYT) is the tightest dim convention (59.119× vs dim_q 219.83×, none 73.981×); no global/A-power scale fixes it (log C/log A non-constant); a deuteron-pinned 0-fit scale mispredicts T/³He/⁴He by -9.517%/23.7%/-97.91% (≫ isospin ±8%). Mirror pair T & ³He at the SAME H₉ need C_knot differing by a factor 1.3671 (robust across dim conventions: 1.3671/1.3216/1.3119) ⇒ C_knot is NOT a function of (n,q₀); it is per-knot Δ_λ. scope-(a): single-universal-C_knot derivation route REFUTED; scope-(b): level-only rescale g(n,q₀) excluded by the mirror inequality (Lean no_level_only_closure). Δ_λ magnitude stays OPEN (bean qou-3q7t). Supersedes c_knot_not_universal_probe.py (whose 41× was right-vs-wrong weight, now resolved). No fit; B_AME diagnostic-only (never inverted); nothing wired; exact mpmath. NOTE: every figure in this description is INTERPOLATED from the values computed in this run — it cannot go stale against its own payload.
tier: scope-(a) refutation of single-universal-C_knot + scope-(b) level-only exclusion; no fit

framing_writhe_test.note: Writhe w(K)=#σ−#σ⁻¹ of the canonical word (averaged interface crossings writhe-neutral): w(D)=w(T)=4, w(³He)=w(⁴He)=8. The omitted Jones/HOMFLY framing factor q₀^{c·w} would need CONSTANT c to close C_knot. The per-isotope c is recorded in `per_isotope.framing_c` above and is not constant; and — decisively, and independently of those values — D&T (same writhe 4) and ³He&⁴He (same writhe 8) have DIFFERENT C_knot, so no writhe-only factor closes it. That pair argument is what carries the exclusion; the c-spread is corroboration. Framing RULED OUT (scope-b).
